bio.intro: I'm Abdul Malik Nasir Musa, a Software Engineer specialized in Mobile & Backend development, based in Lomé, Togo.
bio.p1: My approach is grounded in technical rigor and a deep understanding of systems. Before writing the first line of code, I analyze requirements, define the architecture, and plan for scalability. To me, a successful application is one that lasts, performs, and stays maintainable.
bio.p2: Specialized in native and cross-platform mobile development (Kotlin Multiplatform, Jetpack Compose Multiplatform, Android, iOS) and robust backend architectures (Spring Boot, Java, PostgreSQL, Redis), I build complete solutions: from data modeling to the final user experience, through authentication, security, and deployment. I designed and built CanjiX, a live e-commerce platform used by more than 700 users.

items.desc: Design and development of a complete e-commerce ecosystem for the West African market: Kotlin Multiplatform / Compose Multiplatform mobile app, Spring Boot REST API (2FA authentication, JWT, inventory and payment management), Next.js landing page, and admin CRM. Live in production, used by more than 700 users since April 2026.

Development of a cross-platform desktop launcher (Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform) dedicated to distributing and managing Unreal Engine products: authentication, integrated store, download system, automated installation, and product lifecycle management.

Design of a cross-platform mobile app for managing client accounts and financial transactions, with secure authentication (Firebase, biometrics), CLIENT / ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN role management, offline-first behavior, and PDF financial report generation.
Development of a shop management mobile app (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose) to centralize daily operations: product registration, inventory tracking, and sales management.

process.label: Technical Process
process.title: Methodology
process.subtitle: A structured development cycle to guarantee robust, scalable, high-performing solutions.

steps.title: Analysis & Strategy
steps.desc: Every project starts with a deep understanding of business goals and technical constraints. Together we define the functional scope and choose the technology stack best suited to the solution's long-term viability.

steps.title: Architecture & Modeling
steps.desc: Software architecture is the foundation of scalability. I design the database schema, the API architecture, and the application's overall structure. This phase anticipates technical challenges before implementation begins.

steps.title: Development & Implementation
steps.desc: Code is written with rigor, following Clean Code and DRY principles. Whether for Web (Next.js) or Mobile (Flutter), the focus stays on performance, readability, and maintainability of the source code.

steps.title: Testing & Quality Assurance
steps.desc: Robustness comes from rigorous validation. Unit tests, integration tests, and code review ensure a bug-free experience and optimal security from day one.

steps.title: Deployment & Maintenance
steps.desc: Production releases are secured through CI/CD pipelines. Once deployed, the project enters a phase of monitoring and evolving maintenance to adapt to new needs and stay technologically current.

process.philosophyQuote: “Technical rigor isn't optional — it's the sine qua non of a successful digital product.”
